entries.wording: The parcel has been successfully picked up and is being prepared for transportation
The parcel arrives at the distribution center and is prepared for transport to the next destination
The parcel is dispatched from the transit center to the next destination
The parcel has been collected and is on its way
entries.note: The courier's collection for the delivery round: the reply files it as a delivery scan (派件扫描) with the parcel out for delivery (派件中). The shared rules would read it as transit.

entries.wording: The parcel has been successfully delivered to the recipient
The delivery address is incomplete or incorrect.
entries.note: The reply's problem scan (问题件扫描), hours after the parcel went out for delivery on the same day: the round's outcome.

entries.wording: Delivery was attempted, but no one was available to receive the package at the address; the package was taken to a pickup location for the customer to collect.
entries.note: The round's outcome: no one at the address, so the parcel waits at a pickup location, as other carriers' failed attempts that leave it at one read.
